What was tried: (1) fetched and read the full paper, arXiv:2504.09394 ('Evaluation Under Imperfect Benchmarks and Ratings: A Case Study in Text Simplification', Liu, Nam, Cui & Swayamdipta, USC); (2) fetched the arXiv e-print source tarball (https://arxiv.org/e-print/2504.09394): it contains only the LaTeX source, bibliography and PDF figures, no data files; (3) fetched and inspected the code repository the paper cites in its own first footnote, https://github.com/jliu7350/text-simplification-benchmark: as of 2026-09-19 it holds a single README.md ('Code for Evaluation Under Imperfect Benchmarks and Ratings...') and nothing else, confirmed via the GitHub API's recursive tree listing on the sole 'main' branch -- an empty/dead repository. What the paper describes, for context: SynthSimpliEval pairs 260 complex sentences (60 from SimpEval2022 + 200 synthetic sentences generated by Qwen 2.5 72B Instruct across 20 domains x 750 concept nouns) with simplifications from four Llama 3 models (1B/3B/8B/70B), for 1040 sentence pairs total. Two disjoint scoring pools exist, per the paper text (Section 3.2 and Section 4): (a) an 80-pair pilot (20 of the 260 sentences, 10 from each source, x 4 models) rated by 3 NLP-expert annotators on a genuine 5-point Likert scale (this WOULD map onto CONTRACT.md's likert5 with no invented mapping needed, and is exactly what H3 in PRODUIT.md would want to anchor against SimpEval2022) -- but only the aggregate ICC(2,1) agreement figure (0.671, Human Unified) and mean-score-by-model-size plots are published, never the 80 raw per-annotator or per-pair ratings; (b) the full 1040-pair pool scored by an LLM-as-a-jury of seven models (Gemma 2 27B, Qwen 2.5 32B/72B, Mixtral 8x7B, Deepseek V3, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o), normalised to 0-1 -- this is almost certainly the '~1040 simplifications notees' the mission brief refers to, but it is not human-judged, so folding it into CSMD v2 would violate PRODUIT.md's locked non-objectif 'Pas de LLM-as-judge, ni en baseline ni en professeur'; it is also not published per-item, so the point is moot. H3 (the 60 SimpEval2022 sentences as an inter-corpus anchor) cannot be tested against SynthSimpliEval at all until one of these two pools is obtained directly from the paper's authors -- this is a recommendation, not a decision made here. The only concrete artifacts retrievable are a handful of illustrative example sentences with no attached score, reproduced verbatim in tests/fixtures/synthsimplieval/paper_examples.json for documentation.
